title: Issue-linked native-axis ordering witness for PhiML custom gradients

source_case_schema.source_function: small named dense gradient tensor with available requested input-axis names

parameters.corrective_action: return Dense.native(c_spec['names']) instead of raw natives

transformation_preconditions: The custom-gradient return value is a named dense tensor.
The requested native tensor axis names are available from input specs.
The requested names differ from the gradient tensor's current native order.
The external issue comment and commit document an incorrectly transposed custom-gradient fix.

boundary_condition_compatibility.reason: PhiFlow issue #199 links the failure to a PhiML commit whose message is 'Fix incorrectly transposed custom gradients'; the patch replaces shape-only reconstruction with spec/name-aware native reconstruction.

output_mapping.description: Compare raw native tensor order with name-aware native tensor order for the same gradient values.

metric.name: custom_gradient_native_axis_order_consistency
metric.formula: old_matches_expected = old_native == expected_native; corrected_matches_expected = Dense.native(requested_names) == expected_native

exclusion_rules: Exclude claims about full PhiFlow flow-past-obstacle simulation correctness.
Exclude claims about all PhiML automatic-differentiation behavior.
Exclude defect-rate claims across PhiFlow or PhiML.

verdict_interpretation.pass: The external issue/commit artifacts are present and the witness reproduces the name-aware native-axis ordering correction.
verdict_interpretation.fail: The artifact checks or axis-order metrics contradict the commit-linked semantic correction.
verdict_interpretation.skip: The run was not executed because source artifacts were unavailable.
verdict_interpretation.out-of-relation-domain: The target gradient return value is not a named tensor requiring native axis-order reconstruction.
verdict_interpretation.numerical-tolerance-issue: Not applicable to exact axis-order labels, but retained for schema consistency.
verdict_interpretation.inconclusive: The external issue/commit link or semantic witness evidence is incomplete.

claim_limitations: This MR card supports one external issue/commit-linked native-axis ordering semantic witness for PhiML custom gradients. It does not report full PhiFlow simulation validation, automatic-differentiation benchmark performance, production CFD behavior, or a real-world defect-detection rate.
